scripts.build:web: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode web --outDir dist-web
scripts.wasm: cargo build -p iptv-core --features wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --manifest-path ../core/Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm --out-name iptv_core ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/iptv_core.wasm
scripts.build:mac: tauri build --bundles app && V=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && hdiutil create -volname "MyIPTV $V" -srcfolder ../target/release/bundle/macos/MyIPTV.app -ov -format UDZO ../target/release/bundle/dmg/MyIPTV_${V}_$(uname -m).dmg
